windows.notes: Round 3, from the live 100 % dialog captures (ref/windows/dialogs; scripts/looks_refs_d.py makes the crops and the pixel diff). The frame is now the theme bitmap v3 shows: a rounded #FDFDFD box with a two-ring edge (pixel tables for the four corners, #DCDCDC / #EDEDED top, #D3D3D3 / #DCDCDC foot, #D7D7D7 and #DFDFDF sides) that bleeds 1 px right and down, the 17 px drop-button column with the measured chevron (pixel table, 3 levels at most), and Tahoma 11 px text (ink 89 px wide for 'Against Card Color', as in the capture; the DFMs ask for Tahoma -11). Matched sheets, each beside its crop: combo_box_dialog (Options > Grids, two combos at rest: frame, chevron and text origin equal to 0 levels on the first, 3 to 5 on the second; the other instances of the real control vary by up to 10), combo_box_edit (Search for Card: an editable combo with the focus is the square white frame with the accent underline #5599D5 / #0067C0 / #A0C3E0 and a pale ring: equal except the caret our editor shows), combo_box_pick (Conditional Formatting: a focused list-style combo keeps the rounded frame and shows v3's dotted focus rectangle, 121 x 16 at (3, 3): dots within 5 levels, frame within 10 to 23 levels on the right edge). Round 2 pieces unchanged: the toolbar combo (combo_box_flat) and the drop-down list (combo_box_lists, now with Tahoma rows).
gaps: unverified, no capture shows them: hover (3 % face tint, darker chevron), the drop button hot and pressed, open (the square accent frame is borrowed from the focused editable one), disabled (grays mixed halfway toward the dialog face), read-only, empty with a hint, long text

windows.notes: v3 has no list box of its own, but the Customization window (View > Show Columns, TcxGridTableColumnsListBox) shows one at 100 %, and the control is now that: white rows 19 tall, text 4 in (Tahoma 11), a #C1C1C1 line above, #A1A1A1 on the left, #EAEAEA on the right and #F8F8F8 below, the chosen row #D9EBF9 and a dotted focus rectangle round the focused row. list_box_dialog (the eight-row Columns list, first row chosen and focused) matches its crop in frame lines and fill exactly (0 levels), row pitch and the text boxes within 1 px; the dotted rectangle follows the capture's two-row pattern (the capture draws it with colour fringes, so the dots differ by up to 60 levels). The older rounded #FDFDFD frame and #0078D7 selection belonged to the combo's drop-down and are gone from the list box.

windows.notes: Round 3: v3 has two page control looks, both captured at 100 %. (1) lfUltraFlat, NativeStyle False (Statistics, About; TabsOptions default): redrawn to the capture's geometry: strip starting 5 px before the first tab, the chosen tab a #F0F0F0 box framed by two grey rows (#555555, #A0A0A0) on top and 1 px black sides, the strip's two-row bottom line, 14 tall #A0A0A0 hairlines, a 16 px picture and 6 px gap before the caption, Tahoma 11, the dotted focus rectangle; page_control_about and page_control_stats equal their crops in lines (within 2 levels) apart from the picture bitmaps, text ink boxes within 1 px. (2) lfOffice11 with NativeStyle True (Filter, Customization; new TabsOptions.native): the Windows 11 tab face, unselected tabs 20 tall (#E9E9E9 top, #EEEEEE, #F3F3F3 face, #EAEAEA / #F2F2F2 foot), the chosen tab 22 tall on #F9F9F9 with the page's top edge (#E9E9E9, #F2F2F2) under the others, #E5E5E5 left edges, dotted focus rectangle in the chosen tab: page_control_filter and page_control_custom, text boxes within 1 px, tab edges within 2 px. The tpBottom strip (round 2) is unchanged.
gaps: unverified: hover, pressed and disabled states of every tab style (hot label blue #0066CC and no face change for the ultra-flat strip, no change at all for the native one; disabled ink mixed 60 % to the face); the captures show only the chosen and unchosen tab at rest and the focused chosen tab

Tab widths follow our text widths: v3 draws GDI-hinted Tahoma, which is up to 5 px narrower on long labels (the 'Blocks / Formats / Editions' tab is 2 px wider than the capture, 'Cards' 2 px narrower), so later tabs drift by that much
The pictures of the Statistics tabs are v3's image list bitmaps; drawn glyphs stand in
Accelerator underlines ('&Colors') and the hot-tracked underline are not drawn

The page body is not part of the strip: the native page frame (#E5E5E5 sides, #ECECEC / #EEEEEE / #F1F1F1 foot) and the ultra-flat page's two grey edge rows (#BBBBBB, #D5D5D5) are not drawn by tab_view, which keeps the default strip
Overflowing tabs, multi-row, tabs at the sides or with close buttons are in no capture and not drawn; the native tabs' rounded top corners are drawn square
The widget harness holds 128 element states, so the state sheet has six strips
Text is grayscale-antialiased where the captures are ClearType

windows.notes: The hot zone of v3's TcxSplitter (simple style), redrawn from the Filter window capture at 100 % (splitter_dialog, beside its crop; the strip columns match to 9 levels, the dots' pale ghost included): an 8 wide strip of the dialog face, the zone with a #A0A0A0 frame, #BBBBBB top and foot rows, a #DFDFDF row and a white column inside, a #D5D5D5 shadow row under it, a 4 x 8 '<' chevron 6 px from each end (grey 0 / 80 / 160) and #50A0DF / #A0C8E8 dots every 3 px. Its length is floor(0.3 x strip + 2), centred: 387 gives 118, 463 gives 140 and 497 gives 151, which are the three captured lengths (it resolves the earlier gap about the lengths read off the main window). The live sheet now uses the real strip lengths.
